prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Redesign for Companion Selection: Redesign the pet choice screen into a spotlight stage layout where active pet animations highlight companion traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Screen Anchor Position Setup Screen: Insert a dedicated anchor configuration screen allowing users to pick which corner or taskbar position their pet should inhabit.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_desktop_anchor", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_anchor": {"headline": "Select Desktop Anchor Location", "body": "Choose which corner of your monitor your pet will stay anchored to.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Temperament and Activity Profile Flow: Add a companion personality customization screen between pet selection and certificate issuance to configure desktop activity level.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_temperament_setting", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_temperament_setting": {"headline": "Set Companion Energy & Behavior", "body": "Select whether your pet is energetic, relaxed, or quiet while you work.", "layout": "checklist"}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Creation: Shift the sign-in step to take place immediately after completing the adoption certificate instead of before pet picking.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Quick Restore Hint: Add clear guidance text explaining how cloud account sign-in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your primary account to keep existing desktop pets and restore previous progress."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Multi-Phase Initialization Status Checklist: Display explicit status steps on the waiting screen indicating desktop window initialization progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Companion Engine", "body": "1. Building pet animations... 2. Initializing desktop window overlay... 3. Spawning pet."}}
6: [home, notification] System Tray Alert When Companion Is Ready: Provide an option to send a native operating system notification when companion initialization completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready on your desktop."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Direct Path Option Headline and Body Copy: Reframe choose_path messaging with clear action verbs contrasting instant desktop spawn against custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Meet Your Pet", "body": "Pick an instant starter buddy or build a fully custom desktop companion."}}
8: [finish, incentive] Starter Desktop Accessory Choice Incentive: Offer users a free cosmetic accessory selection prompt on the final onboarding screen before entering desktop mode.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Setup Complete! Pick a Welcome Gift", "body": "Choose a free hat or accessory for your companion to wear right now.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "label": "Select Accessory"}]}}
9: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Layout for Pet Adoption Certificate: Convert adoption_certificate to a two-column split layout displaying the visual certificate alongside official confirmation details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "text": "Official Companion License"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the pet choice screen while preserving its required function.
Adds a valid anchor setup screen to the onboarding flow.
Adds a valid companion temperament setup screen to onboarding.
Reorders sign-in step to after adoption certificate as explicitly permitted by rule 4.
Adds clear account guidance hint to sign-in screen.
Updates waiting screen with explicit progress information.
Adds notification option on the waiting screen within onboarding.
Updates path selection copy while maintaining both path options.
Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'free' and 'gift', violating rule 3.
Redesigns adoption certificate layout while retaining official adoption confirmation.
